output.reason: The brief backs its claim with segmented data: yield fell only in the tiers whose awards were cut, and early-action students processed on time saw nearly the same drop, which points to pricing rather than portal delays. It loses some weight because merit tier is confounded with the merit-review processing delay and the tier data isn't split by round, but its next steps are clear.
